Their stories are told in schools and army units across India so that children may learn about courage and duty. A soldier who wins the Param Vir Chakra is remembered not for wanting glory, but for putting the safety of others before his own life.

questions.text: How many queen bees does a hive have?
questions.explanation: The passage says each hive has one queen bee.
questions.passage: The honeybee is a small insect, but it does a very big job. Honeybees live together in a hive. Each hive has one queen bee, a few hundred drones and thousands of worker bees. The queen lays eggs, while the workers do almost everything else. They clean the hive, feed the young bees, guard the entrance and fly out to collect nectar and pollen from flowers. A worker bee tells the other bees where flowers are by doing a special "waggle dance". Back in the hive, nectar is slowly turned into honey and stored in wax cells that have six sides. As bees move from flower to flower, they carry pollen with them. This helps plants to make fruits and seeds. Without bees, we would have far fewer apples, mustard and many other crops. So the next time you see a bee, do not harm it. Let it do its busy work.

questions.text: Sunita is facing West. She turns left, and then turns left again. Which direction is she facing now?

questions.textHi: 40 विद्यार्थियों की पंक्ति में अरुण दाईं ओर से 15वें स्थान पर है। बाईं ओर से उसका स्थान क्या है?
questions.explanation: Position from left = 40 − 15 + 1 = 26.

questions.text: A is older than B. C is older than A. D is younger than B. Who is the oldest?
questions.textHi: A, B से बड़ा है। C, A से बड़ा है। D, B से छोटा है। सबसे बड़ा कौन है?
questions.explanation: The order from oldest is C, A, B, D, so C is the oldest.
questions.explanationHi: आयु का क्रम: C > A > B > D; इसलिए C सबसे बड़ा है।

questions.text: In a queue, Sara is 9th from the front and 6th from the back. How many people are in the queue?
questions.textHi: एक कतार में सारा आगे से 9वें और पीछे से 6वें स्थान पर है। कतार में कितने लोग हैं?

questions.text: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be after 45 days?
questions.textHi: आज बुधवार है। 45 दिन बाद कौन-सा दिन होगा?
questions.explanation: 45 days = 6 weeks + 3 days. Wednesday + 3 days = Saturday.
questions.explanationHi: 45 दिन = 6 सप्ताह + 3 दिन; बुधवार + 3 = शनिवार।

questions.text: What is the angle between the two hands of a clock at 4 o'clock?
questions.textHi: 4 बजे घड़ी की दोनों सुइयों के बीच कितना कोण होता है?
questions.explanation: The hands are 4 hour-marks apart and each mark is 30°, so 4 × 30° = 120°.

questions.text: If "×" means "−", "−" means "+", "+" means "÷" and "÷" means "×", find the value of 16 + 4 × 2 − 3.
questions.explanation: After changing the signs: 16 ÷ 4 − 2 + 3 = 4 − 2 + 3 = 5.

questions.explanationHi: नियम: पहली संख्या का वर्ग + दूसरी का वर्ग; 36 + 49 = 85।

questions.text: Find the missing number. Row 1: 8, 2, 4. Row 2: 15, 3, 5. Row 3: 24, 4, ?
questions.explanation: In each row the first number divided by the second gives the third: 24 ÷ 4 = 6.
questions.explanationHi: हर पंक्ति में पहली संख्या ÷ दूसरी = तीसरी: 24 ÷ 4 = 6।

questions.text: Find the missing number: 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, ?
questions.explanation: Each term is (a square number) + 1: 1+1, 4+1, 9+1, 16+1, 25+1, so next is 36 + 1 = 37.
questions.explanationHi: हर पद = वर्ग संख्या + 1; अगला 36 + 1 = 37।

questions.text: In a group of 50 children, 30 play cricket and 25 play football. Every child plays at least one of the two games. How many play both?
questions.textHi: 50 बच्चों के समूह में 30 क्रिकेट और 25 फ़ुटबॉल खेलते हैं। हर बच्चा कम से कम एक खेल खेलता है। कितने बच्चे दोनों खेल खेलते हैं?
questions.explanation: 30 + 25 = 55, which is 5 more than 50. These 5 children were counted twice, so 5 play both.

questions.text: Which pair is best shown by two circles that do not touch each other at all?
questions.textHi: कौन-सा युग्म ऐसे दो वृत्तों से सबसे अच्छा दर्शाया जाएगा जो एक-दूसरे को बिल्कुल नहीं छूते?
questions.explanation: No animal is both a cat and a dog, so the circles are separate. Some girls are students and all mangoes are fruits, so those circles touch or overlap.
questions.explanationHi: कोई जानवर बिल्ली और कुत्ता दोनों नहीं हो सकता, इसलिए वृत्त अलग रहेंगे।

questions.text: Which of these words will look exactly the same in a mirror?
questions.textHi: इनमें से कौन-सा शब्द दर्पण में बिल्कुल वैसा ही दिखेगा?
questions.explanation: A mirror reverses left and right. M and O look the same when reversed and MOM reads the same backwards. N, D and P change in a mirror.
questions.explanationHi: दर्पण बाएँ-दाएँ उलट देता है। M और O वैसे ही दिखते हैं; N, D, P बदल जाते हैं।

questions.text: How many of these letters look the same in their water image: B, C, D, E, F, G?
questions.textHi: इनमें से कितने अक्षर जल प्रतिबिंब में वैसे ही दिखते हैं: B, C, D, E, F, G?
questions.explanation: B, C, D and E look the same when turned upside down in water; F and G do not. So 4.
questions.explanationHi: B, C, D, E जल प्रतिबिंब में वैसे ही दिखते हैं; F और G नहीं। इसलिए 4।

questions.text: If the English alphabet is written in reverse order (Z to A), which letter will be 7th from the left?
questions.textHi: यदि अंग्रेज़ी वर्णमाला उल्टे क्रम (Z से A) में लिखी जाए, तो बाईं ओर से 7वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
questions.explanation: Z, Y, X, W, V, U, T: the 7th letter is T.
questions.explanationHi: Z, Y, X, W, V, U, T: 7वाँ अक्षर T है।

questions.textHi: उस आकृति को चुनिए जो अन्य से भिन्न है।
questions.explanation: Figures (B), (C) and (D) are the same L-shape with a dot, only turned round. Figure (A) is its mirror image, so it cannot be made by turning.

questions.text: What is the place value of 5 in 6,85,231?
questions.explanation: 5 is in the thousands place, so its value is 5 × 1,000 = 5,000.
questions.explanationHi: 5 हज़ार के स्थान पर है, इसलिए उसका मान 5,000 है।

questions.text: What is the successor of 99,999?
questions.textHi: 99,999 का परवर्ती (अगली संख्या) क्या है?
questions.explanation: The successor is the number just after: 99,999 + 1 = 1,00,000.

questions.text: The Roman numeral for 94 is:
questions.textHi: 94 को रोमन अंकों में कैसे लिखते हैं?
questions.explanation: 94 = 90 + 4 = XC + IV = XCIV.
questions.explanationHi: 94 = 90 + 4 = XC + IV = XCIV।

questions.text: What is the value of the Roman numeral CXL?
questions.textHi: रोमन अंक CXL का मान क्या है?
questions.explanation: C = 100 and XL = 40, so CXL = 140.

questions.text: What is the difference between the largest and the smallest 4-digit numbers?
questions.textHi: चार अंकों की सबसे बड़ी और सबसे छोटी संख्या का अंतर क्या है?
questions.explanation: Largest 4-digit number = 9,999; smallest = 1,000. 9,999 − 1,000 = 8,999.

How many prime numbers are there between 1 and 20?

questions.explanation: They are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17 and 19, which is 8 numbers.

questions.text: What is the HCF of 18 and 27?
questions.textHi: 18 और 27 का महत्तम समापवर्तक (HCF) क्या है?
questions.explanation: 18 = 9 × 2 and 27 = 9 × 3, so the HCF is 9.

questions.text: What is the LCM of 12 and 18?
questions.textHi: 12 और 18 का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) क्या है?
questions.explanation: Multiples of 18: 18, 36, … and 36 is also a multiple of 12. So the LCM is 36.

questions.text: What is the smallest number which leaves a remainder of 2 when divided by 6 and by 8?
questions.textHi: वह सबसे छोटी संख्या कौन-सी है जिसे 6 और 8 से भाग देने पर हर बार शेषफल 2 बचे?
questions.explanation: LCM of 6 and 8 is 24. Adding the remainder: 24 + 2 = 26.
questions.explanationHi: 6 और 8 का LCM 24; शेषफल जोड़कर 24 + 2 = 26।

Find the value: 3/5 × 25

questions.text: Write 36/48 in its simplest form.
questions.textHi: 36/48 को सरलतम रूप में लिखिए।
questions.explanation: Divide both by their HCF 12: 36 ÷ 12 = 3, 48 ÷ 12 = 4, so 3/4.
questions.explanationHi: दोनों को HCF 12 से भाग दें: 3/4।

questions.text: Find the value: 12.5 − 4.75
Find the value: 1.2 × 0.5
questions.explanation: 12 × 5 = 60, with two decimal places: 0.60 = 0.6.

questions.explanation: 0.45 = 45/100 = 9/20 (dividing both by 5).

questions.text: A bicycle bought for ₹2,400 is sold for ₹2,700. What is the profit?
questions.textHi: ₹2,400 में खरीदी गई साइकिल ₹2,700 में बेची गई। लाभ कितना हुआ?
questions.explanation: Profit = selling price − cost price = 2,700 − 2,400 = ₹300.
questions.explanationHi: लाभ = विक्रय मूल्य − क्रय मूल्य = ₹300।

questions.text: An article bought for ₹500 is sold for ₹450. What is the loss percent?
questions.textHi: ₹500 में खरीदी गई वस्तु ₹450 में बेची गई। हानि प्रतिशत क्या है?

questions.text: The cost price of a watch is ₹800. It is sold at a profit of 15%. What is the selling price?
questions.textHi: एक घड़ी का क्रय मूल्य ₹800 है। उसे 15% लाभ पर बेचा गया। विक्रय मूल्य क्या है?
questions.explanation: Profit = 15% of 800 = ₹120. Selling price = 800 + 120 = ₹920.

questions.text: A shirt marked at ₹600 is sold at a discount of 20%. What is its selling price?
questions.textHi: ₹600 अंकित मूल्य की एक कमीज़ 20% छूट पर बेची गई। उसका विक्रय मूल्य क्या है?
questions.explanation: Discount = 20% of 600 = ₹120. Selling price = 600 − 120 = ₹480.

questions.text: The population of a village is 5,000. It increases by 10% in a year. What will the population be after one year?
questions.textHi: एक गाँव की जनसंख्या 5,000 है। एक वर्ष में यह 10% बढ़ती है। एक वर्ष बाद जनसंख्या कितनी होगी?

questions.text: Aman scored 45 marks out of 60. What percentage of marks did he get?
questions.textHi: अमन ने 60 में से 45 अंक प्राप्त किए। उसे कितने प्रतिशत अंक मिले?

questions.text: A shopkeeper sells a toy for ₹330 and makes a profit of 10%. What was the cost price of the toy?
questions.textHi: एक दुकानदार एक खिलौना ₹330 में बेचकर 10% लाभ कमाता है। खिलौने का क्रय मूल्य क्या था?
questions.explanation: Selling price = 110% of cost price, so cost price = 330 × 100 ÷ 110 = ₹300.

questions.text: In a school of 800 students, 35% are girls. How many boys are there?
questions.textHi: 800 विद्यार्थियों वाले विद्यालय में 35% लड़कियाँ हैं। लड़के कितने हैं?

questions.text: What is the simple interest on ₹1,500 at 8% per year for 2 years?
questions.textHi: ₹1,500 पर 8% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्ष का साधारण ब्याज कितना होगा?

questions.text: Write the ratio 24 : 36 in its simplest form.
questions.textHi: अनुपात 24 : 36 को सरलतम रूप में लिखिए।

questions.text: The ages of Anil and Bina are in the ratio 3 : 5, and the sum of their ages is 40 years. What is Bina's age?
questions.textHi: अनिल और बीना की आयु का अनुपात 3 : 5 है और उनकी आयु का योग 40 वर्ष है। बीना की आयु क्या है?
questions.explanation: Total parts = 8; one part = 40 ÷ 8 = 5. Bina = 5 × 5 = 25 years.
questions.explanationHi: कुल भाग 8; एक भाग = 5; बीना = 5 × 5 = 25 वर्ष।

questions.text: 5 kg of rice costs ₹275. What is the cost of 8 kg of rice?
questions.textHi: 5 kg चावल का मूल्य ₹275 है। 8 kg चावल का मूल्य क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: 1 kg costs 275 ÷ 5 = ₹55, so 8 kg cost 55 × 8 = ₹440.

questions.text: Kamal can complete a job in 20 days. What part of the job will he complete in 5 days?
questions.textHi: कमल एक काम 20 दिन में पूरा करता है। 5 दिन में वह काम का कितना भाग करेगा?
questions.explanation: In 1 day he does 1/20, so in 5 days he does 5/20 = 1/4.

questions.text: A boy walks at 4 km/h. How long will he take to walk 10 km?
questions.textHi: एक लड़का 4 km/h की चाल से चलता है। 10 km चलने में उसे कितना समय लगेगा?
questions.explanation: Time = distance ÷ speed = 10 ÷ 4 = 2.5 hours = 2 hours 30 minutes.

questions.text: 72 km/h is equal to how many metres per second?
questions.textHi: 72 km/h कितने मीटर प्रति सेकंड के बराबर है?
questions.explanation: Multiply by 5/18: 72 × 5 ÷ 18 = 20 m/s.

questions.text: How many days are there in a leap year?
questions.textHi: लीप वर्ष में कितने दिन होते हैं?
questions.explanation: A leap year has 366 days because February has 29 days.
questions.explanationHi: लीप वर्ष में फ़रवरी 29 दिन की होती है, इसलिए 366 दिन।

questions.text: A film started at 6:40 p.m. and ended at 9:15 p.m. How long was the film?
questions.textHi: एक फ़िल्म शाम 6:40 बजे शुरू होकर रात 9:15 बजे समाप्त हुई। फ़िल्म कितनी लंबी थी?
questions.explanation: 6:40 to 8:40 is 2 hours; 8:40 to 9:15 is 35 minutes. Total 2 hours 35 minutes.

questions.text: What is the perimeter of a square of side 15 cm?
questions.textHi: 15 cm भुजा वाले वर्ग का परिमाप क्या है?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 4 × side = 4 × 15 = 60 cm.
questions.explanationHi: परिमाप = 4 × भुजा = 60 cm।

questions.text: What is the area of a rectangle 14 m long and 8 m wide?
questions.textHi: 14 m लंबे और 8 m चौड़े आयत का क्षेत्रफल क्या है?
questions.explanation: Area = length × breadth = 14 × 8 = 112 square metres.
questions.explanationHi: क्षेत्रफल = 14 × 8 = 112 वर्ग मीटर।

questions.text: A rectangular park is 40 m long and 25 m wide. What is the cost of fencing it at ₹12 per metre?

questions.text: How many degrees are there in a right angle?

questions.explanation: A right angle measures exactly 90°.
questions.explanationHi: समकोण ठीक 90° का होता है।

questions.text: An angle that is less than 90° is called:

questions.text: In a pictograph, one symbol stands for 5 cars. On Monday there are 6 symbols and on Tuesday 4 symbols. How many cars are shown for both days together?
questions.textHi: एक चित्रालेख में एक चिह्न 5 कारों को दर्शाता है। सोमवार को 6 चिह्न और मंगलवार को 4 चिह्न हैं। दोनों दिनों में कुल कितनी कारें दर्शाई गई हैं?
questions.explanation: Total symbols = 6 + 4 = 10, and 10 × 5 = 50 cars.

questions.text: Rina had ₹500. She spent 2/5 of it on books and ₹120 on shoes. How much money is left with her?
questions.textHi: रीना के पास ₹500 थे। उसने उसका 2/5 भाग पुस्तकों पर और ₹120 जूतों पर खर्च किए। उसके पास कितने रुपये बचे?

questions.text: Who wrote "Gitanjali"?

questions.text: Who wrote "The Discovery of India"?
